scope: Bounded encoder INT8 convolution micro-replays after causal-zero optimization; no new production change.

includes: one prequantized INT8 convolution into a preallocated FP16 output
timing_scope.inputs: Synthetic INT8 tensors at three captured full-size H3 geometries and one short shape; first two temporal planes set exactly zero for causal runs.
timing_scope.comparison: Each replay has its own paired current-production baseline; do not combine independent absolute baselines into a new speedup.

decision: Reject all tested encoder candidates. Keep production causal-zero pipeline unchanged; no end-to-end speedup claim.

current_profile_context.source: Latest causal-zero encode Nsight Systems trace

checks: D2 nonzero temporal prefix with causal skipping disabled

candidates.name: Unaligned scalar address decomposition
candidates.reason: Activation async staging was lost; real-size operator latency increased 60.7%-80.4%.

candidates.name: Scalar carries and loop-carried pointer recurrence
candidates.reason: Activation async staging was lost and compiler reported 68-72 spills on real-size shapes; latency increased 559%-602%.

candidates.name: Scalar decomposition with explicit 16-byte base alignment
candidates.reason: Activation async staging and baseline resource usage were restored, but real-size changes ranged from 0.30% faster to 2.05% slower. Short D2 improvement does not establish full-video gain.

candidates.name: Original causal kernel with BK32 instead of BK64
candidates.reason: Shared allocation halved, registers remained 254, and real-size latency increased 79.5%-99.1%.

compiler_evidence.source: Static generated PTX and Triton GPU IR, plus loaded-kernel resource metadata; no Nsight Compute counters.
compiler_evidence.representative_shape: C128->128, D17, H=W256, BM=BN=128, four warps, four stages
compiler_evidence.baseline: Both activation and weights use three-buffer async global-to-shared copies with 16-byte contiguity.
compiler_evidence.unaligned_scalar_and_carry: Activation changes to loop-local ordinary tt.load with ld.global.b8 instructions; weights retain async staging. Carry retains a full 128x64 activation pointer matrix across loop iterations.
compiler_evidence.minimal_fix: tl.multiple_of(input_base + tap_offset, 16), guarded by contiguous channel stride and 16-byte-multiple remaining strides, restores activation async copies.
notes: Static instruction counts are not dynamic execution counts.
Shared memory/register metadata alone does not prove occupancy, bandwidth, utilization or the dominant warp stall.
No new NCU permission probe or driver permission change was performed in this round.

next_steps: Do not repeat scalar/carry/smaller-K tuning without a new mechanism.
Future encoder work should justify a new producer-consumer fusion or target remaining FP16 convolution work, preserving FP16 rounding and GroupNorm reduction order.
